caseName: Indiana v. United States Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit
caseNameFull: Indiana v. United States Court of Appeals for the Seventh Circuit

opinions.text: Motion of respondent Brooks [see Brooks v. Center Township, 485 F. 2d 383] for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Motion for leave to file petition for writ of mandamus, prohibition, and/or certiorari denied.
